_comment: Toolchain pin for the layout/ flow (klt drc, later extract / lvs). This is
a capability list plus an exact commit: every layout/ runner must look
each klt_required_commands entry up in `klt --help` and fail loudly,
naming the missing command, rather than skip the check.
Pin set by issue #3. The commit is the klayout-tools commit behind the
`klt` that ran the sim smoke on this host (`klt --version` reported
0.7.1.dev1765+gb61f753d0369; the static version string lags the commit,
so the SHA is the pin). Keep this comment append-only: record each later
klt_install              VCS URL pinned with @<sha>, never a branch.
klt_required_commands    every `klt <command>` this repo's runners use.
klt_last_verified_commit klt_install's commit, restated; update both.
klayout_package_min      floor for the pip `klayout` package.
